# gitmoap_service_account_tokens (Data Source)

List a service account's access tokens. The account's tokens, newest first, with their names, scopes, bindings, expiry and last use; never the secrets. Callers who can manage service accounts at the account's home group or repository may list them (Maintainers and above with the built-in roles). Each read is recorded in the audit log.

The token needs `token:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "platform" {
  full_path = "acme/platform"
}

resource "gitmoap_group_service_account" "ci" {
  group_id     = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.platform.group_id
  name         = "ci"
  access_level = "developer"
}

data "gitmoap_service_account_tokens" "example" {
  sa_id = gitmoap_group_service_account.ci.service_account_id
}
```
